author: YTSanitizer
name: ytsanitizer
short: YouTube ?si= cleaner with auto, manual, and delete toggle
description: Strips YouTube's ?si= share identifier from links and retriggers the embed. Auto mode listens for new posts. Manual mode only runs when someone uses the command. Deleting the original post is a separate toggle and defaults off.
install_msg:
YTSanitizer is installed and idle.

`[p]ytsanitizeset mode auto` — clean new posts as they arrive
`[p]ytsanitizeset mode manual` — command only (default)
`[p]ytsanitizeset mode off` — disable both
`[p]ytsanitize` — clean a link, or reply to a post to clean that post
`[p]ytsanitizeset delete` — toggle deleting the original post

Send Messages and Embed Links are required. Manage Messages is required only when delete is on.
Replace the author field in info.json before publishing.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server settings only (mode and whether to delete the original post). It does not store messages, user ids, or link history.
